Use case: identity-preserve. Production whole-body cel-animation sprite sheet for Prof. MARCELINO, an original Brazilian physics teacher / Muay Thai fighter. Image 1 original body establishes exact identity and costume; Image 2 original close face is the facial identity lock. Preserve mature adult male, swept short grey hair, black rectangular glasses, prominent straight nose, clean-shaven narrow face and serious eyes, warm light tan skin. WHITE short-sleeve T-shirt, NAVY full-length track pants with a single ORANGE stripe down each outer leg, WHITE wrist/hand wraps, BARE FEET. Same face throughout; no beard, gloves, headband, shorts, boots or new accessories.
Crisp classic 1990s arcade 2D inked cel animation, confident dark contour, clean flat colors, two sharp shadow tones, detailed face, readable folds and muscular anatomy. No blurry painting, 3D, gradients, face collage, effects, shadows on floor or motion blur. New entire-body drawings in each cel.
Transparent RGBA. Exactly 8 isolated cels in 2 columns x4 rows, large portrait canvas. SAME right-facing orthographic 3/4 view and SAME anatomical size throughout: standing adult height about 330px, head about48px. BENT / CROUCHED / AIRBORNE cels keep that head size and limb length, NEVER enlarged to fill their cells. Empty space above low poses. Wide gutters, fingers/toes and hair entirely visible, no touching adjacent cels, no text or numbering. Image3 if provided is the NEW approved model for style and consistent proportions.
Frames in row-major order: 0 Muay Thai neutral guard both wrapped fists held near cheeks, upright long leg stance. 1 tiny breathing change in guard, elbows tucked, feet stay planted. 2 defensive high guard both forearms shielding face. 3 firm recoil blocking a punch, shoulders braced, feet planted. 4 crouch guard bent knees and lowered hips, head remains original size. 5 crouch block crossed forearms. 6 jumping rising knees slightly bent one foot down, guard up. 7 jump apex compact raised knee and rear leg bent, guard up. Preserve the original middle-aged face and glasses, do not rejuvenate or over-muscle him.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation atlas, original Physics-based kinetic force effects for a classic 1990s arcade 2D fighter. Transparent RGBA background. Exactly16 separated effect drawings arranged4columns x4rows, no human bodies, text, equations, letters, icons or numbers. Sharp dark teal outlines with bright CYAN, pale ice blue and warm AMBER inner energy; two crisp cel tones and small white contact cores. No fog, paint splashes, electric lightning, blur, gradients,3D, large opaque circles or background. Big clear gutters, no overlapping cels.
Row1:4 consecutive frames of a RIGHT-moving compressed kinetic impulse, a compact bright core toward the RIGHT, three thin concentric elliptical pressure rings around it, sharp horizontal thrust trails extending LEFT. The core stays the same diameter, rings fluctuate subtly, all travel right.
Row2:4 frames impact of a kinetic shockwave: small white star flash, expanding segmented cyan/amber radial pressure fracture, broken thin ring, finally small dissipating radial flecks. Clear negative space between pieces.
Row3:4 frames a tall rising right-convex kinetic crescent from a Muay Thai rising knee: narrow sweeping cyan/amber arc with two crisp curved parallel force contours and short streaks. Grows upward, peaks as clean crescent, breaks into short arc fragments, dissipates.
Row4:4 frames of gathering energy in wrapped hands: tiny cyan/amber fragments orbiting a small core, tighter brighter symmetrical pressure rings, sharp release flare facing RIGHT, final fading ring fragments. Small crisp luminous core, open center. Bold intentional animation silhouettes, no motion blur. All effects wholly contained in their own cell.
